name: Hosting
summary: Labs runs your process on its server: a loopback port that is yours for the life of the id, a systemd unit that brings it back after a crash, environment injected at start, logs in the journal. Caddy is the only thing that talks to it.

options.start: required — the command that starts your server, run in your checkout, e.g. node server.mjs
options.install: optional — run before start on every deploy, e.g. npm ci --omit=dev
